We're building a new internet to...

accelerate communication in high-performance dist

DoubleZero is a global fiber network for high performance distributed systems and blockchains, bringing high-performance networking and hardware acceleration to crypto. It's not a new L1 or L2, it's the world's first N1. Base layer network infrastructure for distributed systems.

The mission is simple...

increase bandwidth, reduce latency.

Working to accelerate blockchain by a decade.

DoubleZero is creating the first dedicated physical infrastructure layer for blockchain communication, addressing the fundamental bottleneck that software alone cannot solve. By combining fiber links run by independent contributors with edge filtering hardware in a permissionless network, DoubleZero enables blockchain systems to achieve dramatically higher performance without sacrificing decentralization while maintaining crypto-economic security guarantees.

Two rings, DoubleZero.

DoubleZero's dual-ring architecture reduces consensus time while freeing up validator compute resources and bolstering security.

Decentralized systems need decentralized infrastructure.

DoubleZero is a permissionless network. Anyone can contribute unused bandwidth, turning isolated links into a unified global fabric. The network grows stronger with each new contributor, mirroring the systems it serves—distributed, resilient, and participant-owned. When decentralized apps run on decentralized infrastructure, DoubleZero can deliver performance without compromising principles.
